summaries.title: Tool Documentation Enables Zero-Shot Tool-Usage with Large Language Models

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模、感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Second, on a newly collected realistic tool-use dataset with hundreds of available tool APIs, we show that tool documentation is significantly more valuable than...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Second, on a newly collected realistic tool-use dataset with hundreds of available tool APIs, we show that tool...；Third, we highlight the benefits of tool documentations by tackling image generation and video tracking using...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 37 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: SelfCheck: Using LLMs to Zero-Shot Check Their Own Step-by-Step Reasoning
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **SelfCheck** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、思维链（Chain-of-Thought (CoT)）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：In particular, we investigate whether they can be used to identify individual errors within a step-by-step reasoning。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **GSM8K, MATH**。实验设计与验证细节：We test the method on three math datasets-GSM8K, MathQA, and MATH-and find that it successfully recognizes errors and, in turn, increases final predictive...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We test the method on three math datasets-GSM8K, MathQA, and MATH-and find that it successfully recognizes errors and, in turn, increases final predictive performance）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 24 赞），本工作为突破 **思维链与树搜索 (CoT & Search)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Skills-in-Context Prompting: Unlocking Compositionality in Large Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **Skills-in-Context Prompting** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：To bridge this gap, we propose skills-in-context (SKiC) prompting, which instructs LLMs how to compose basic skills to resolve more complex problems。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **MATH**。实验设计与验证细节：However, even the current state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle with this form of reasoning。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（However, even the current state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle with this form of reasoning；With such prominent features, SKiC prompting is able to achieve state-of-the-art performance on challenging...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 24 赞），本工作为突破 **数学竞赛与形式化定理证明 (Math & Proof)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Predicting masked tokens in stochastic locations improves masked image modeling
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Masked** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉生成与世界模型（Vision & World），并引入 Masked Image Modeling (MIM) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this work, we propose FlexPredict, a stochastic model that addresses this challenge by incorporating location uncertainty into the model。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **ImageNet**。实验设计与验证细节：However, MIM is challenging because it requires predicting semantic content in accurate locations。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **1.6%, 2.5%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our approach improves downstream performance on a range of tasks, e.g, compared to MIM baselines, FlexPredict boosts ImageNet linear probing by 1.6% with ViT-B and by 2.5% for...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 17 赞），本工作为突破 **机制可解释性与思维链监控 (Interp & CoT Monitor)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Three Bricks to Consolidate Watermarks for Large Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Three Bricks to Consolidate Watermarks** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：First, we introduce new statistical tests that offer robust theoretical guarantees which remain valid even at low false-positive rates (less than 10^{-6})。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Second, we compare the effectiveness of watermarks using classical benchmarks in the field of natural language processing, gaining insights into their real-world...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Third, we develop advanced detection schemes for scenarios where access to the LLM is available, as well as multi-bit watermarking）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 15 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
